text:
Ana: Quick sync — planning the next webinar on 'Serving LLMs at Product Scale' for May 10. Need to lock: speaker availability across timezones, rehearsal slot, recording/captions, and lead-routing. Two proposed webinar times: 9am PT / 12pm ET OR 4pm PT / 7pm ET. Which do folks prefer?
Mike: I prefer the earlier slot (9am PT / 12pm ET) — better for EMEA overlap without it being late.
Sylvia: +1 earlier. Speakers confirmed so far: Jenna (runtime/ops), Priya (customer case study), Tom (benchmarks). Jenna asked for a dry run and wants a mic check.
Devon: For inbound routing: anything with enterprise interest should go to queue: enterprise-high; demo requests to webinar-sdr. Need a consistent tag/utm so marketing and sales can filter.
Sam: Please upload final deck to /marketing/webinars/serve-llm/ by EOD Tue. Also we need a short demo playbook (2-3 bullets) for the moderator to run if demo fails.
Ana: Rehearsal windows — propose Tue 3pm PT or Wed 11am PT. Jenna/ Priya/ Tom — can you confirm?
Jenna: Wed 11am PT works best for me. I want 30 mins for slides + 20 for demo dry run.
Priya: I can do Wed 11am PT. I'll prepare the customer slide and two talking points on ROI.
Tom: 12pm ET (earlier slot) is fine. Wed rehearsal OK.
Devon: Routing snippet for the ops team — we'll tag leads with utm_campaign and a custom field. Example payload for the webhook: ```
{
  "utm_campaign": "serve-llm-05-10",
  "lead_source": "webinar",
  "tags": ["webinar","serve-llm","enterprise"],
  "route": "enterprise-high"
}
```
Sylvia: Recording/captions — vendor for captions is currently otter.ai (auto-transcript) + manual QC. We should include a permission slide at start for recording and post a transcript next day.
Sam: Moderator script v1 attached (uploaded). Key cue: if demo latency > 2s on demo page, fallback to pre-recorded clip (in /marketing/webinars/serve-llm/assets).
Ana: Can we confirm: webinar time = 12pm ET (9am PT), rehearsal Wed 11am PT, deck deadline Tue EOD, lead routing tag = serve-llm-05-10, captions = Otter + manual QC. If no objections I'll lock calendar and create Zoom event.
Priya: Confirmed.
Tom: Confirmed.
Jenna: Confirmed.
zoom-bot: Meeting created: "Serve LLMs at Product Scale — Rehearsal" Wed 11:00 PT — invites sent to speakers + ops.
Ana: Thanks all — action items: Sylvia to create caption workflow, Devon to confirm webhook mapping to AE queue, Sam to upload final demo artifacts, Mike to prep short promo copy for announcement. I'll post the run-of-show draft later today. :thumbsup:
Mike: Will draft promo copy and share here by EOD.
Devon: I'll post the routing rules doc in sales ops and tag @sales-leads.
Sylvia: I'll start the Otter export test after rehearsal and note turnaround time.
Ana: Perfect — closing thread, I'll update calendar and the run-of-show in this channel once done.
